
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `adt datapreview osql` | Execute an ABAP Open SQL SELECT statement |

## `adt datapreview osql`

Execute an ABAP Open SQL SELECT statement

```bash
adt datapreview osql [options] <statement>
```

**Arguments**

| Argument      | Description               | Default |
| ------------- | ------------------------- | ------- |
| `<statement>` | ABAP SQL SELECT statement |         |

**Options**

| Option                  | Description                                   | Default |
| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `-o, --output <format>` | Output format: human (default) or json        | `human` |
| `-r, --rows <n>`        | Maximum number of rows to return              | `100`   |
| `--noheadings`          | Suppress column headings                      |         |
| `--noaging`             | Disable SAP aging (bypass browser cache flag) |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
